idea: Financial literacy training for design and creative firms
buyer: Design, architecture and creative agency leadership
pain: Creative businesses are run without financial discipline
v1: A one-day workshop for one firm's leadership
channel: Her architecture network extended to creative agencies
verdict: Warm and deliverable, but the same poor-buyer problem as the rest of the design cluster.

why.distribution: Warm through architecture, extending plausibly to adjacent creative firms.
why.demand: Inferred; creative firms rarely prioritise this spend until a crisis.
why.fmf: She has lived both sides - creative practice and rigorous finance.
why.leverage: Materials reuse but she must deliver each session.
why.ceiling: £4.5k x 44 workshops = £198k, an impossible delivery load for a low-paying segment.

ceiling_arithmetic: £4.5k x 44 workshops = £198k, which is nearly a workshop a week. Creative firms also resist this spend. Realistic: 8-12 = £36-54k.
carries: Warm channel and genuine dual credibility.
kills: Delivery load and a buyer that treats this as discretionary until it is too late.
test: Quote £4k to three creative firm leaders.
test_fail: They agree it matters and do not buy.
